EC1: 1. Unable to ambulate at least 150 feet [OR] prior to stroke, or experienced intermittent claudication while walking;
EC2: 2. history of congestive heart failure [OR], unstable cardiac arrhythmias [OR], hypertrophic cardiomyopathy [OR], severe aortic stenosis [OR], angina [OR] or dyspnea [OR] at rest or during ADL's;
EC4: 4. Preexisting neurological disorders [OR], dementia [OR] or previous stroke;
EC6: 6. Legal blindness [OR] or severe visual impairment;
EC7: 7. history of psychosis [OR] or other Axis I disorder that is primary;
EC9: 9. Severe arthritis [OR] or other problems that limit passive range of motion;
EC10: 10. History of DVT [OR] or pulmonary embolism within 6 months;
EC11: 11. Uncontrolled diabetes [OR] with recent weight loss [OR], diabetic coma [OR], or frequent insulin reactions;
EC12: 12. Severe hypertension [AND] with systolic >200 mmHg and diastolic >110 mmHg at rest;
EC13: 13. attempt of suicide [OR] in the last 2 years or at suicidal risk [AND] assessed by SCID interview;
EC14: 14. Previous or current enrollment in a clinical trial to enhance motor recovery; 15) currently exercising ≥ 2 times per week (≥20 minutes);
EC15: 16) Presence of non-MR compatible implants [OR], pregnancy [OR] or severe claustrophobia.
